event_data.context: The prior task inferred a central loader failure because two fixtures with explicit $development-system:development-workflow invocation passed while many natural fixtures failed. Explicit invocation bypasses the contextual routing behavior the canonical suite is intended to measure, and recent focused natural runs show mixed case-level outcomes rather than one global failure. Keep behavior prompts natural by default and the no-plugin baseline unprimed. Add forced invocation only as a paired diagnostic for targeted-plugin and full-marketplace modes. Use repeated paired evidence before changing skill triggers, instructions, or rubrics. Do not weaken semantic rubrics or restore Claude-provider scope.
event_data.summary: Preserve natural, contextual skill selection as the canonical Codex behavior gate and add a reusable opt-in forced-invocation mode that attributes failures to routing versus post-selection skill behavior.
event_data.title: Separate contextual skill routing from forced-invocation diagnostics
